codexbar

First-time setup: install the ppkg CLI once (ensure npm’s global bin directory is on your PATH; see catalog for more):

npm install -g @patdx/ppkg@0.11.0

Then install this package:

ppkg add codexbar

Remove:

ppkg remove codexbar

Or without installing the CLI:

npx @patdx/ppkg@0.11.0 add codexbar
